newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian shares end the week on bearish note.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian shares end the week on bearish note.

text.p: Hungarian share prices extended their losses on the Budapest Stock Exchange on Friday to make it a week-long bearish period, traders said.
The BUX index ended at 3,546.02 points, down 58.97. Spot spot share turnover totalled 892.5 million forints.
The market's decline was in harmony with price movements on international bourses, traders said.
"Foreign bourses have been in a corrective phase these days," said Robert Forgo of MKB Securities.
Oil company MOL remained in the forefront of trading although its turnover of less than 80,000 shares was not particularly strong. MOL closed at 1,575 forints, down 25.
Traders attributed MOL's price fall to the launch of trading in Russia's Gazprom shares in London, which attracted intense interest from investors.
"I think its price fall is in some relation with Gazprom's shares," Forgo said.
